Entry.JapaneseText: 古都ダリルシェイド
Entry.EnglishText: Darilsheid Prison

Entry.JapaneseText: <Loni>
Entry.EnglishText: Loni

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kyle>
Entry.EnglishText: Kyle

Entry.JapaneseText: <Judas>
Entry.EnglishText: Judas

Entry.JapaneseText: 古都ダリルシェイド
Entry.EnglishText: Darilsheid Prison

Entry.JapaneseText: おい<Kyle>、相手にすんな あいつ、あからさまにあやしいぞ
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, <Kyle>, don't mess with him. That guy's got some serious shit going on.

Entry.JapaneseText: <03:00000000>休みますか？ はい いいえ
Entry.EnglishText: <03:00000000> Do you want to rest? Yes No

Entry.JapaneseText: こらあっ！ 話も聞かずに牢屋に閉じこめるたぁ どういう了見だ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, I know you're out there! What's the big idea, locking us up in prison without even listening to our side of the story!

Entry.JapaneseText: おいこら！ 責任者、出てこい!!
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, I'm not screaming for my health here! Bring out the person in charge!!

Entry.JapaneseText: くそッ！ しくじっちまったぜ まさか、こんなハメになるとは････
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit! Well, that was a complete flop. Never would've guessed that things would wind up like this...
Nhh...w, where are we...?

Entry.JapaneseText: えっと、ラグナ遺跡に行って レンズを見つけたんだけど、割れちゃって アタモニ神団に捕まって････
Entry.EnglishText: Lemme think, we went to the Laguna Ruins and found the Lens, but it shattered into pieces and we got caught by the Church of Atamoni...

Entry.JapaneseText: ････あれ？ それから、どうしたんだっけ？
Entry.EnglishText: Huh? What happened after that again?

Entry.JapaneseText: ････のん気だねぇ、おまえは
Entry.EnglishText: Boy, ain't got a care in the world, do you?

Entry.JapaneseText: 見てのとおり 牢にぶちこまれたんだよ たぶん、ダリルシェイドの地下だろう
Entry.EnglishText: As you can see, we've been thrown in a cell. I'm guessing that we're probably in the jail underneath Darilshade.

Entry.JapaneseText: えっ
Entry.EnglishText: Eh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 笑ってる････
Entry.EnglishText: He's laughing...

Entry.JapaneseText: お、おい、<Kyle>!? どうした!? 頭でも打ったか!? ちょっと、見せてみろ！
Entry.EnglishText: H, hey, <Kyle>!? What's wrong!? Did they hit you on the head too!? C'mere, let me take a look at it!

Entry.JapaneseText: ちがうよ、<Loni> オレさ、今すっごく幸せなんだ！ だってさ、冒険がはじまったんだよ！
Entry.EnglishText: No, no, <Loni>, it's not that. It's just that I'm really happy right about now! I mean, my adventure's finally begun!
Adventure...?

Entry.JapaneseText: あの子が現れた瞬間、オレ、思ったんだ 冒険がはじまったんだって
Entry.EnglishText: The moment that girl appeared, I thought to myself, "My adventure has begun."

Entry.JapaneseText: だってさ、レンズの中から出てきて 「英雄を探しているの」だよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, she came out of a Lens and said "I'm searching for a hero," you know!

Entry.JapaneseText: お話の中でしか････いや、お話の中だって こんなことなかった！ それが、オレの目の前で起こったんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: All we did was...no. Although all we did was talk to her, look at everything that happened! {02}And it all took place right before my very eyes!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだ、<Loni>！ オレ、クレスタへ戻ったら旅に出るよ
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, I know, <Loni>! When we get back to Cresta, I'm going on a journey.
Journey...?

Entry.JapaneseText: そう、英雄になるための冒険の旅！
Entry.EnglishText: Yup, a journey full of adventure in order to become a hero!

Entry.JapaneseText: あの子が探してるのはオレなんだ！ いまは違うかもしれないけど ････そう！ 未来のオレだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm the one that girl is searching for! I might not be the one right now, but...I know! It's the future me!

Entry.JapaneseText: それをあの子に教えに････ いや、わからせに行くんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm going to go tell her that... no, I'm going to make her see that!

Entry.JapaneseText: 未来のおまえ････か フッ････嫌いじゃないぜ、そういうの
Entry.EnglishText: The future you...huh. Heh...can't say that has such a bad ring to it.

Entry.JapaneseText: よし！ その旅、俺もつきあうぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alrighty then! I'm gonna keep you company on that journey of yours!

Entry.JapaneseText: えっ!? でも<Loni>は アタモニ神団に････
Entry.EnglishText: Eh!? But <Loni>, you're in the Church of Atamoni...

Entry.JapaneseText: あんな連中、こっちから願い下げだ 今回のことで、よーくわかったよ！ あそこは、俺のいるべき場所じゃねえ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm cutting ties with those jerks. This incident really taught me something: that place ain't where I belong!

Entry.JapaneseText: 俺のいるべき場所は････ <Kyle>、おまえのとなりだ････ だから、俺はおまえにつきあうぜ
Entry.EnglishText: The place where I belong is... by your side, <Kyle>... That's why I'm goin' along with ya.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Loni>････
Entry.EnglishText: <Loni>...

Entry.JapaneseText: それにな、俺はスタンさんの････ おまえのオヤジさんの代わりが できたらと思ってる
Entry.EnglishText: And besides, you could say that I think of myself as a substitute for Sta-... your father.

Entry.JapaneseText: あの日から、ずっと････
Entry.EnglishText: Ever since that day...
That day...?

Entry.JapaneseText: フッフッフ････ ハッハッハッハッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hm hm hm... Ha ha ha ha!

Entry.JapaneseText: だれだッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Who's there!?

Entry.JapaneseText: おまえ、自分が英雄になれるなどと 本気で思っているのか？ だとしたら、おめでたいヤツだ
Entry.EnglishText: Do you seriously think that you can become a hero? If so, then you're about as green as they come.

Entry.JapaneseText: ねぇ、なんでオレが英雄になれないの!?
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, why can't I become a hero!?

Entry.JapaneseText: フッ、簡単なことだ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, it's a simple matter, really.

Entry.JapaneseText: 英雄とは、過去の功績に対して 人々から贈られる称号
Entry.EnglishText: The title of hero is awarded to a person by the masses based on his orher past achievements.

Entry.JapaneseText: 自らなろうとするものではないし ましてや、なりたいと思って なれるものでもない
Entry.EnglishText: It's not something that you try to become, much less something that you can become just by wanting to become one.

Entry.JapaneseText: ずいぶんわかったような口を きくじゃないか まるで、自分が英雄だとでも言いたげだな
Entry.EnglishText: Well, someone sure sounds like Mr. Know-It-All, now doesn't he. You even talk as if you're a hero yourself.

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕自身は英雄じゃない だが、そう呼ばれる人物を 少なくとも四人、知っている
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not a hero. But I know of at least four people who are characterized as being heroes.

Entry.JapaneseText: 四人？ ははぁ～ん････ 俺たちなんざ、知ってるだけじゃない そのうち二人と知り合いだぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: Four people? Oh ho ho... The thing is, we don't just know about them, we're personally acquainted with two of them!

Entry.JapaneseText: なにせ、こいつの両親が、そうだからな
Entry.EnglishText: Anyhow, I guess we owe that to the fact that they're his parents.

Entry.JapaneseText: 両親が････英雄!? ････！ そうか、あいつらの････！
Entry.EnglishText: Your parents are...heroes!? ...! I see, you're their...!

Entry.JapaneseText: へっへ～！ 驚いて 声も出ないって感じだな
Entry.EnglishText: Heh heh...! I take it that the shock has left you at a loss for words, eh?

Entry.JapaneseText: そんなことより、<Loni> 早く、クレスタに戻ろうよ！ そうじゃないと、冒険に････
Entry.EnglishText: Never mind that, <Loni>, let's hurry up and get back to Cresta! If we don't, then we can't go on an adventure...

Entry.JapaneseText: わかってるって とはいえ、ここの牢屋は 頑丈だからなぁ････
Entry.EnglishText: Alright already. That being said though, the door to this cell is built like a friggin' rock...

Entry.JapaneseText: おい、おまえたち
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you two.

Entry.JapaneseText: んだよ？ 俺たちは忙しいんだよ 見てわかんねぇか？
Entry.EnglishText: Whaddaya want? We're busy here, can't ya tell?

Entry.JapaneseText: ここを出たいのだろう？ なら、僕にいい考えがある
Entry.EnglishText: You want to leave this place, am I right? In that case, I have a great idea.

Entry.JapaneseText: ホント!? なに、いい考えって!?
Entry.EnglishText: Really!? What's this great idea of yours!?

Entry.JapaneseText: おいおい、<Kyle> こいつの言うことなんか
Entry.EnglishText: 信用すんなよ Hey now, <Kyle>, don't go trusting what this guy has to say.

Entry.JapaneseText: 仮面で顔を隠してるような輩だぜ？ なに考えてるか わかったもんじゃないぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: You see how the guy's hiding his face behind a mask? There's no tellin' what the man's thinking, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、こんなところでグズグズしてたら あの子、どんどん遠くへ行っちゃうよ！ オレ、早く冒険に出たいんだよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: But that girl is just going to get farther and farther away from us if we sit around in a place like this! I want to hurry up and start on my adventure!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ････わかったよ おまえの好きにしろ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Fine, I hear ya. Do as you please.

Entry.JapaneseText: 決まり！ それじゃ、教えてよ！ え～っと････
Entry.EnglishText: It's settled then! So, tell us about it! Um...

Entry.JapaneseText: 名前か？ ････名前など、僕にとっては 無意味なものだ
Entry.EnglishText: My name?... Things such as names are meaningless to me.

Entry.JapaneseText: おまえたちの好きなように 呼べばいい
Entry.EnglishText: You two can call me whatever you'd like.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃあ････<Judas>！
Entry.EnglishText: Okay then... <Judas>!

Entry.JapaneseText: <Judas>････か まあ、それで我慢してやろう
Entry.EnglishText: <Judas>...huh. Oh well, I'll just have to deal with it.

Entry.JapaneseText: で、<Judas>さんよ こっからどうやって脱出するつもりだ？
Entry.EnglishText: So, Mr. <Judas>, how do you intend to escape from this lovely place?

Entry.JapaneseText: 簡単なことだ 出口から出ればいい
Entry.EnglishText: A simple enough matter. All we need to do is leave through the exit.

Entry.JapaneseText: 出口からって････おい！
Entry.EnglishText: Through the exit... hey!

Entry.JapaneseText: さがっていろ
Entry.EnglishText: Stand back.

Entry.JapaneseText: ハァッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Haa!
Awesome...!

Entry.JapaneseText: なにをぼーっとしている？ さっさといくぞ
Entry.EnglishText: What are you gawking at? Let's get moving.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kyle>は 称号「<item:00000809>」を得ました <Kyle> acquired the title "<item:00000809>".
<Loni>は 称号「<item:0000080C>」を得ました
Entry.EnglishText: <Loni> acquired the title "<item:0000080C>".

Entry.JapaneseText: <Judas>が仲間になりました
Entry.EnglishText: <Judas> joined your party.

Entry.JapaneseText: 開かない
Entry.EnglishText: It won't open.

Entry.JapaneseText: いってらっしゃいませ
Entry.EnglishText: Have a good day.
It'll be <0B:00000001>{14}{34}{08}{C0}<0B:00000000> gald a night. Would you like to stay?

Entry.JapaneseText: お泊まりになりますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Would you like to stay?

Entry.JapaneseText: ごゆっくりお休みください
Entry.EnglishText: Have a good night.

Entry.JapaneseText: おはようございます
Entry.EnglishText: Good morning.

Entry.JapaneseText: お金が足りません
Entry.EnglishText: Not enough money.

Entry.JapaneseText: またのおこしをお待ちしております
Entry.EnglishText: See you again soon.

Entry.JapaneseText: {16}{25}{CA}{C0}を手に入れました
Entry.EnglishText: Acquired {16}{25}{CA}{C0}.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何もありません
Entry.EnglishText: There's nothing here.
